study type: Experimental study (mouse model) and human cohort analysis
exposure: Gut microbiota (GM) transplantation (human CS-GM or VD-GM)
outcome: Severity of oxazolone-induced dermatitis (ear thickness, clinical and histopathological assessment)
Immune cell populations in draining lymph nodes
Risk of developing atopic dermatitis (AD) in humans
finding: While CS-GM enhanced a Th2-biased immune response in mice, it did not affect the severity of oxazolone-induced dermatitis, and in the human cohort, delivery mode did not affect the risk of developing AD.
mod_finding: Although CS-GM led to a higher IgE concentration and a higher proportion of Th2 cells in mice, suggesting a potential role in allergic sensitization, it did not worsen the severity of experimentally induced dermatitis.
